# Sources · trading-technique-course

- Gates, minimum trade counts, quarter-risk start, violation limit: `../paper-trading.md` graduation gate and `trade-journal` (this plugin) · indicator defaults and the breakout failure rule: `technical-signals` · the 2-retest limit borrows the multiple-testing idea of [Harvey, Liu and Zhu (NBER w20592)](https://www.nber.org/papers/w20592) already cited in `trade-journal`; the number 2 is ours (starting value, not yet measured)
- Level rules in `levels.md` are common textbook forms written as countable rules for this course; they are teaching material, not tested strategies (not yet measured on Thai data)
- Red/green test of this skill with a fresh agent: not yet run (ยังไม่ได้รัน); eval cases are in `plugins/trading-finance/evals/trading-technique-course-*`
